title: Source
description: Brings data into a topic from outside. A source is trusted code with no model: it calls a public API on a schedule and publishes each new item, mapped field by field into the topic's schema.

type.description: http_poll: GET a URL on an interval and publish each new item.

url.description: https only, no credential (public APIs). Its host is added to the egress list.

topic.description: Topic each item is published to.

items_path.description: Where the list of items is in the response, e.g. hits. Leave empty if the response is the list.

id_field.description: Item field that uniquely identifies it. Items already published are skipped.

map.description: Topic field -> item field (dotted path allowed). Missing values are left out.

limit.description: At most this many items per poll.

timeout.description: Give up on a request after this long.
